address: via al Ponte Calvi 20 r, Genoa, 16124, Italy
bio: In the heart of the old town, just a short walk from the aquarium, is a venue with evening tones, but with large windows that make it welcoming even at lunchtime. During warm weather, a few tables outside allow people to enjoy the busy promenade. Although the fish for sale counter of the early days is no longer there, the sea continues to take centre stage with excellent raw materials and classic dishes, always generous in portions....
